nodes.description: Address stored as the privileged owner of the SimpleToken contract; set from tx.origin in the constructor and used as the only authorized caller for delegate, distribute and list.
External protection-system address called via raw low-level call in the checkBots modifier and in distribute/list.
Cached Uniswap style pair address used as an argument to the bot protection call and set once in the constructor.
Public mapping of account balances; updated with unchecked += and -= arithmetic and overwritten wholesale in distribute and list.
Public nested mapping of allowances; written in approve and decremented with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom.
Fixed public supply constant used for distribution math (totalSupply * 6 / 100) in list.
Hard-coded UniswapV2Router02 interface used for the addLiquidityETH external call in list.
Hard-coded WETH style address used to derive the pair address in the constructor.
Constructor that takes ownership from tx.origin, derives uniPair and pre-authorizes the router and the pair to spend unlimited allowances.
Public payable transfer entry point that simply forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as the sender.
Public payable transfer implementation guarded by the checkBots modifier; performs allowance and balance checks then mutates balances with unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable allowance setter that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without any zero-address or return-value safeguards.
Owner-restricted function that executes an arbitrary delegatecall with attacker-influenced target and data.
Internal pure helper that deterministically derives a pair address via keccak256 of the sorted token addresses.
Owner-restricted airdrop style function that calls the bot protection contract and then overwrites balances of every recipient in a loop.
Owner-restricted liquidity listing function that mints to self/sender, calls addLiquidityETH with a timestamp deadline and then overwrites recipient balances.
Modifier that performs an external low-level call to botProtection before the wrapped function body executes.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks, allowance spending and as the implicit sender of transfer.
Origin address used to assign owner in the constructor and to grant unlimited allowances.
Miner-influenced timestamp used to compute the Uniswap deadline (block.timestamp + 600).
Low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary address supplied by the caller, executing untrusted code in the token storage context.
Raw low-level call to the botProtection contract inside the modifier, executed before any state update in transferFrom.
Raw low-level call to the botProtection contract with selector 0xd5eaf4c3 invoked before balance overwrites in distribute and list.
External payable call into the Uniswap router with a deadline derived from block.timestamp and msg.value forwarded.
Unchecked subtraction allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value without SafeMath.
Unchecked balanceOf arithmetic (balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value) without SafeMath.
Arithmetic on block.timestamp (block.timestamp + 600) used as the router deadline, making execution time miner dependent.
Unchecked arithmetic totalSupply * 6 / 100 assigning a share of supply to the caller.
Source account of the transfer, also used as the allowance owner.
Destination account of the transfer.
Amount transferred, subtracted from allowance and balances.
Spender address granted an allowance.
Allowance amount written for the spender.
Target address for the delegatecall, fully caller controlled.
Arbitrary calldata forwarded to the delegatecall target.
Recipient address array used for balance overwrites and bot protection input.
Fixed amount assigned to every recipient in distribute.
Liquidity amount assigned to the contract balance and passed to addLiquidityETH.
Per-recipient amounts used for the post-liquidity distribution loop.
First token address used when deriving the pair.
Second token address used when deriving the pair.
Recipient forwarded from transfer into transferFrom.
Amount forwarded from transfer into transferFrom.
Boolean and returndata bytes decoded from the botProtection call; the require on it can be bypassed by a malicious protection contract.
Success flag returned by the delegatecall.
Sorted token pair locals used to compute the pair hash.
Loop index iterating over the recipient arrays in distribute and list.

edges.reason: The checkBots modifier wraps transferFrom and executes its body before the function body runs.
botProtection state variable is the call target of the low-level call in the modifier.
uniPair is passed as an argument into the bot protection call.
The external botProtection call in checkBots completes before balanceOf is updated in transferFrom, allowing a malicious protection contract to re-enter.
_from parameter flows into the transferFrom logic.
_to parameter flows into the transferFrom logic.
_value parameter flows into the transferFrom logic.
msg.sender is compared against _from to decide whether an allowance must be consumed.
transfer delegates all work to transferFrom.
_to parameter is forwarded by transfer.
_value parameter is forwarded by transfer.
msg.sender is used as the implicit sender passed to transferFrom.
transferFrom performs the unchecked allowance subtraction on _value.
_value is the operand of the unchecked allowance subtraction.
allowance mapping entry is read and decremented without SafeMath.
transferFrom mutates balances with unchecked -= and += operations.
_value is the operand of the unchecked balance updates.
balanceOf mapping entries are read and updated with unchecked arithmetic.
_spender keys the allowance mapping write in approve.
_value is written into the allowance mapping in approve.
approve writes the allowance state variable without any guard.
msg.sender is the allowance owner set by approve.
tx.origin is used in the constructor to derive the privileged owner and unlimited allowances.
owner is assigned directly from tx.origin, granting privileges to the transaction origin.
The constructor calls pairForPancake to derive the pair address.
_amounts is length-checked against _tos in list.
tokenA parameter feeds the pair derivation.
tokenB parameter feeds the pair derivation.
token0/token1 locals are hashed to produce the pair address.
The derived pair address is stored in uniPair.
uniPair is initialized in the constructor.
The constructor grants unlimited allowances to the router and the pair.
routerForUniswap is used during constructor initialization.
wrappedBinance is used as a pair token in the constructor.
delegate restricts execution to msg.sender equal to owner.
owner state variable is the authorization reference in delegate.
delegate executes a delegatecall with caller-controlled target and data.

The delegatecall success flag is returned by delegate.

owner state variable is the authorization reference in distribute.
_tos supplies the recipients overwritten in distribute.
amount is assigned to every recipient balance in distribute.
distribute calls the botProtection contract directly.
botProtection state variable is the call target for the distribution hook.
The external botProtection call returns before the recipient balance loop runs, allowing reentrancy into the balance overwrite.
distribute writes arbitrary balances into balanceOf without any accounting checks.
Loop index i controls the recipient iteration in distribute.

owner state variable is the authorization reference in list.
_numList configures the liquidity amount in list.
_amounts supplies the values written to recipients in list.
_tos supplies the recipients for both the bot hook and the distribution loop in list.
list performs an external payable call to the Uniswap router.
routerForUniswap is the receiver of the addLiquidityETH call.
The router deadline argument is derived from block.timestamp, making the call miner dependent.
block.timestamp is the operand of the deadline arithmetic.
list computes block.timestamp + 600 as the liquidity deadline.
list computes totalSupply * 6 / 100 without SafeMath and assigns it to the caller.
totalSupply is the operand of the unchecked percentage arithmetic.
list also invokes the botProtection contract before the distribution loop.
list sets balanceOf of the contract, the caller and every recipient.
Loop index i controls the recipient iteration in list.
list reads totalSupply to compute the caller allocation.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _from only exists to feed the transferFrom logic.
Parameter _to only exists to feed the transferFrom logic.
Parameter _value only exists to feed the transferFrom logic and its unchecked arithmetic.
Parameter _spender is only used to key the allowance write in approve.
Parameter _value is only written into the allowance mapping by approve.
Parameter a exists only as the delegatecall target.
Parameter b exists only as the delegatecall calldata.
Parameter _tos is consumed by the distribute balance overwrite when first introduced.
Parameter amount is consumed only by the distribute loop.
Parameter _numList is consumed only by the list liquidity flow.
Parameter _amounts is consumed only by the list distribution loop.
Parameter tokenA is used only inside pairForPancake.
Parameter tokenB is used only inside pairForPancake.
Parameter _to is only forwarded by transfer.
Parameter _value is only forwarded by transfer.
The notABot/isNotBot locals only hold the result of the botProtection call.
The success local only holds the delegatecall result.
The token0/token1 locals are intermediate values of the pair derivation.
The loop index i is a temporary counter for the distribute iteration.
